request: LEAD CHANGELOG 194 (7) and the coordinator relay of line 194: 070BG over-range behaviour at the FA-1 relight peaks and its effect on the 30 bar abort, the comparator, the Pc-valid flag and the logged FA-1 peak
tags: SIM (SIL chain on COMB SIM histories; inputs ASSUMED where marked). The transducer output above full scale is MISSING from the datasheet: v_sat is swept, not known. Not hardware, not a physical validation.

chain.pressure_node: head (the Pc tap is at the head top, SenseLineParams comment; aft run as a sensitivity)
chain.pre_light: 50 ms at P0 (cold flow at the start lift), filter settled on P0
chain.tail: P_at_25ms held to 100 ms after the light [ASSUMED; conservative for over-pressure]
chain.sense_line: sil::SenseLine defaults: L 0.30 m, ID 1.59 mm PTFE, V_end 0.5 cm3, T 350 K, n 1.15, N 16 [ASSUMED]; "off" = head pressure at the transducer
chain.transducer: first-order lag tau_x 0.9 ms (SIL pc_tau: 10-90 % rise 2.0 ms = the DATASHEET bound < 2 ms, i.e. the slowest response the datasheet allows) or 0.1 ms (faster unit; sensitivity); output 0.5 + 4 p_g/70 bar g, limited at v_sat

v_sat_V.4.74: just below the 4.75 V over-range check: silent clip at 74.2 bar g
v_sat_V.4.50: clip at full scale (70 bar g): silent
v_sat_V.none: reference only, not physical for a 5 V ratiometric transducer: the true pressure through the same chain with no transducer or ADC limit

chain.adc: ADS131M04 4 kSPS samples (instantaneous; the sinc3 response is not modelled), PC_SIG range to 4.99 V [DERIVED: 1.2 V FS / 0.2404 divider 12.7k/4.02k; 5.04 V with the 330 kOhm input], 4:1 average to the 1 kHz reading, worst of 4 phases. The limit is applied to each sample (transducer output, then ADC); sil/sim.cpp limits the 1 kHz average at 4.95 V instead, which over-reads above full scale (no effect below it)
chain.firmware: cfg::kPcSensorMax_V 4.75 V (IGNITION: HARD_START on that tick; any state: fault::PC_SENSOR, sticky until DISARM in SAFE; PC_VALID = 0); LowPass2 50 Hz + Persist cfg::kPcOverPressureTime_s 5 ms on the FILTERED channel at 30 bar abs; E2 by the relative rule (rise >= 0.8 bar filtered AND raw, floor 1.8 bar abs, 10 ticks)
chain.comparator: PC_SIG -> RC 5.283 ms -> trip 2.298 V (31.47 bar g, nominal) / 2.208 V (low band edge); U331 latch forces the ARM bus off
chain.configurations: head with the sense line (tau_x 0.9 ms); head without the line (tau_x 0.9 and 0.1 ms); aft with the line (tap-location sensitivity); each with v_sat 4.95 / 4.74 / 4.50 / none
chain.sensitivities_not_proposals: comparator RC 10 and 20 ms at the low band edge; filtered persistence 10 and 15 ms
chain.counts: counts are over Combustion's parametric grid (O/F, fuel time, residence, pool, entrance, initial gas); they are not probabilities
